newsitem.title: NEPAL: Two Indonesian men scale Mount Everest.
newsitem.headline: Two Indonesian men scale Mount Everest.

text.p: Two Indonesians have become the first Southeast Asian men to scale Mount Everest, Nepal's Tourism Ministry said on Sunday.
Last September, an Indonesian woman, Clara Sumarwati, reached the summit from the Tibetan side.
The ministry named the two men as Misirin, 30, an army sergeant, and Asmujiono, 25, a soldier, both from Jakarta. They reached the 8,848-metre (29,028 ft) summit on Saturday afternoon.

The two Indonesians were the 677th and 678th people to claim to have reached the highest point on earth. They were accompanied by two Nepali Sherpas and three Russian guides, all with previous Everest conquests.
